pip.backupDanger: This looks like a full backup file. Restoring replaces this business's data and is admin-only — Pip doesn't handle restores. Use the Backup & Restore page instead.
pip.deliveredNote: In the Receipt Inbox — it stays as uploaded until you scan or post it there.
pip.dropHere: Drop it here — Pip will take a look
pip.fileGone: The file itself is gone (files aren't kept after a reload) — drop it again to send it.
pip.openTray: Pip — add files or open Pip's tray
pip.ownerOnly: Receipt uploads are owner-only here — an owner can send this from their account.
pip.receiptCard: Receipt → Receipt Inbox. It'll sit as uploaded until you scan it.
pip.scanDone: Scanned — review it in the Receipt Inbox when you're ready.
pip.scannedNote: Scanned ✓ — review & post in the Receipt Inbox
pip.trayEmpty: Nothing here yet. Drop a receipt anywhere on the page, or use Add files.
